يقتتلان (form VIII)
# يَقْتَتِلَانِ (yaqtatilāni) /jaq.ta.ti.laː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of اِقْتَتَلَ (iqtatala)
# يُقْتَتَلَانِ (yuqtatalāni) /juq.ta.ta.laː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of اُقْتُتِلَ (uqtutila)
